proposed_title: AP Tracker Lists 25 Promises, With Five Marked Kept as of December 2025
description_medium: The AP promise-tracker dataset, last modified December 3, 2025, listed 25 selected Trump promises: five marked “Kept,” nine “In progress,” and eleven “It’s complicated.” This is a dated distribution of AP’s status labels for that tracked set, not an assessment of every campaign pledge. The snapshot does not establish that promise volume created a manageability problem or exceeded administrative capacity.
description_long: An AP tracker dataset retrieved from the interactive project lists 25 selected Trump campaign promises and gives each an AP status. Its recorded last-modified date is December 3, 2025. In that snapshot, five promises were labeled “Kept,” nine “In progress,” and eleven “It’s complicated.” The records include pledge text, promise dates and links to AP reporting or related actions, allowing readers to see what the tracker counts and how AP categorized the selected commitments. The snapshot supports a specific account of AP’s tracker and its dated status distribution. It is not a complete audit of all campaign promises, and the labels are AP’s assessments at that time. The dataset does not measure staffing, legal workload, administrative capacity, or the effect of making many promises. It therefore cannot substantiate the original claim that high promise volume produced a manageability problem in office. The title is narrowed to the observable tracker snapshot, while that causal claim remains unsupported.
